mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comment (post_id, member_id, parent_id, content) VALUES (#{postId}, #{memberId}, #{parentId}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.post_id, c.member_id, c.parent_id, m.nickname, c.content, c.deleted, c.created_at, c.updated_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment_like cl WHERE cl.comment_id = c.id) AS like_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM comment_like cl WHERE cl.comment_id = c.id AND cl.member_id = #{memberId, jdbcType=BIGINT}) AS liked FROM comment c JOIN member m ON m.id = c.member_id WHERE c.post_id = #{postId} ORDER BY COALESCE(c.parent_id, c.id), c.id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment WHERE parent_id = #{parentId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM comment WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND parent_id IS NOT NULL
